Enable to compile styles and assignments with only opening, warning, and closing comments. This does not affect add-on operation or performance. By default, MenuFlex uses detailed comments in bzmf_final.less to help troubleshoot icon and setting issues. Once resolved, some admins prefer a cleaner output; this option removes most descriptive comments. The bzmf_final.less template is recompiled each time you save settings below.

Note: When standard icon assignments are used, individual icon assignments can be removed by entering a navid: single (e.g. forum:), or overridden by entering a navid:iconname pair (e.g. forums:comments) in the 'Font Awesome Custom Icons' option below.
Note: The above icon color options can be overridden per-icon by entering a navid:iconname:style:color quad (e.g. forums:comments:solid:red) in the 'Font Awesome Custom Icons' option below.

Use any combination of singles, pairs, trios and quads, one per line, to add custom Font Awesome icons to menu options.
  • Singles: Use navid: singles (e.g., forum:) to remove standard icon assignments if you are using 'Standard Icon Assignments' above.
  • Pairs: Use navid:iconname pairs (e.g., forums:comments) to add new icon assignments or override 'Standard Icon Assignments'.
  • Trios: Use navid:iconname:style trios (e.g., forums:comments:solid) to set a specific per-icon style. Trios override the 'Font Awesome Menu Icon Styling' option above.
  • Quads: Use navid:iconname:style:color quads (e.g., forums:comments:solid:red) to set a specific per-icon color. Quads override the 'Font Awesome Menu Icons Color' options above.
  • Valid style names: light, regular, solid, duotone, and brands.
  • Valid color formats: Named color, Hexadecimal, RGB(a), HSL(a), and XenForo Color ID.
  • Comment lines (starting with #) and blank lines can be used to help organize your custom menu icons.
Note: 'Enable Font Awesome Menu Icons' option above must be selected to display custom menu icons.

Choose the default Font Awesome icon style for your menu options. This style will be applied to all enabled icons (standard and custom) by default.
